title: 最多单词数的发件人
summary: 累计每个发件人所有消息的单词数，返回总单词最多者；并列返回字典序最大名字。
insight: 消息按单空格分词，空格数加一就是词数。Map 累加后按总数优先、名字字典序次优比较。
pitfalls: 同一发件人可有多条消息

solutions.title: 累计词数与字典序平局
solutions.idea: 汇总每个发件人后执行二级最大比较。
steps: 每条 message 的 words=spaces+1，累加到 sender
遍历 Map，count 更大或相等且 sender 更大时更新答案

code.java: class Solution { public String largestWordCount(String[] messages,String[] senders){Map<String,Integer> count=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<messages.length;i++){int words=1;for(char ch:messages[i].toCharArray())if(ch==' ')words++;count.merge(senders[i],words,Integer::sum);}String answer="";int best=-1;for(Map.Entry<String,Integer> entry:count.entrySet())if(entry.getValue()>best||entry.getValue()==best&&entry.getKey().compareTo(answer)>0){best=entry.getValue();answer=entry.getKey();}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun largestWordCount(messages:Array<String>,senders:Array<String>):String{val count=HashMap<String,Int>();for(i in messages.indices)count[senders[i]]=(count[senders[i]]?:0)+messages[i].count{it==' '}+1;var answer="";var best=-1;for((sender,total) in count)if(total>best||total==best&&sender>answer){best=total;answer=sender};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string largestWordCount(vector<string>& messages,vector<string>& senders){unordered_map<string,int> count;for(int i=0;i<(int)messages.size();++i)count[senders[i]]+=1+std::count(messages[i].begin(),messages[i].end(),' ');string answer;int best=-1;for(auto& [sender,total]:count)if(total>best||total==best&&sender>answer){best=total;answer=sender;}return answer;} };
